title: 高盛亚太总裁：不裁员反扩招，技术投入成增长引擎
speaker: Kevin Sneader

segments.en: where are you in headcount did you increase headcount this year because everything's gone well we're hiring you know we are out they're hiring one of the things I always say to my colleagues about headcounts remember two things
segments.zh: 你们的员工规模如何？今年是否扩招了？因为一切进展顺利，我们正在招聘。关于员工规模，我常对同事说，记住两点。

segments.en: that really shape how to think about headcount in this moment the first is we did not seek to cut our footprint dramatically when things were not the way they are right now so the footprint was preserved which gives us a foundation
segments.zh: 第一，在市场不佳时，我们没有大幅缩减规模，保留了业务布局，这为我们奠定了基础。

segments.en: and the second point is a lot of our businesses do not scale with headcount they scale with technology and one of the things we've been doing here in this region is investing in our technology infrastructure
segments.zh: 第二，很多业务并不随人员规模扩张，而是随技术扩张。我们一直在本区域投入技术基础设施。

segments.en: yes because of AI but also because we saw an opportunity to close some gaps to reset and improve the technology offering that we have
segments.zh: 是的，因为人工智能，也因为看到机会来弥补差距、重置并改进我们的技术产品。

segments.en: and that gives us a lot of capacity for growth that we're using right now right
segments.zh: 这为我们提供了很大的增长空间，我们正在利用这一点。
